关于我
首页介绍
你好，我是 姝玥。
法律 · 商业 · 跨境合作
中国法学本科、格拉斯哥大学国际商法硕士，目前生活在比利时。
我对企业服务和跨境项目尤其感兴趣，也希望在中国与欧洲之间的实际项目中，逐步将自己的法律背景、研究能力和跨文化经历结合起来。
四个标签
⚖ 法律背景
🌍 中国 · 英国 · 比利时
🤝 跨境协作
🎵 音乐与文化
不止于法律。
法律塑造了我理解问题的方式，但真正吸引我的，并不是孤立地研究一条规则，而是看见它如何进入真实的商业环境，又如何与企业、人与具体项目发生联系。
我一直很喜欢处在不同领域的交汇处：既需要理解专业信息，也需要听懂不同的人真正关心什么；既可以安静地研究和梳理问题，也会享受沟通、合作，以及一个原本模糊的想法逐渐变得清晰、具体的过程。
从中国到英国，再到现在生活在比利时，不同的学习、工作和生活环境也让我越来越确定，自己希望发展的并不是一条非常单一的职业路径。我更期待以法律作为专业基础，同时保持对商业、人与不同文化的好奇，在跨境企业服务和实际项目中不断学习，也真正参与其中。

我的工作方式
好奇与求知
先理解，再行动。
我习惯先理解一件事情为什么这样运作，再思考自己应该如何参与。
结构化思考
让复杂的问题变得清晰。
我喜欢把零散、复杂的信息整理成清晰的结构、问题和下一步行动。
关注人与合作
连接人与不同的视角。
我喜欢听别人怎么想，也享受沟通、协作以及连接不同观点和需求的过程。
认真可靠
先核实，不想当然。
对需要准确性的事情，我更习惯核实，而不是想当然地下结论。
首页结尾
理解 · 梳理 · 连接 · 核实

01 About | English
Hero
Hi, I'm Shuyue.
Law · Business · Cross-border Collaboration
With a background in Chinese law and an LLM in International Commercial Law from the University of Glasgow, I am now based in Belgium.
I am particularly interested in enterprise services and cross-border projects, where I hope to bring together my legal background, research skills and international experience in practical China–Europe work.
Four Tags
⚖ Legal Foundation
🌍 China · UK · Belgium
🤝 Cross-border Mindset
🎵 Arts & Culture
More than a legal background.
Law has shaped the way I understand problems, but what truly interests me is not studying a rule in isolation. It is seeing how that rule enters real business settings and connects with companies, people and specific projects.
I have always enjoyed being at the intersection of different fields: understanding professional information while also listening to what different people really care about; researching and organising issues quietly, while also enjoying communication, collaboration and the process of seeing an initially vague idea become clearer and more concrete.
From China to the UK, and now living in Belgium, different learning, working and living environments have made me increasingly certain that I do not want to pursue a narrowly defined career path. I look forward to building on law as my professional foundation, while remaining curious about business, people and different cultures, continuing to learn through cross-border enterprise services and practical projects, and taking an active part in them.

How I Work
01 Curious
Understand before acting.
I like understanding how things work before deciding how to approach them.
02 Structured
Make complexity manageable.
I enjoy turning scattered information into clear structures, questions and next steps.
03 People-oriented
Connect people and perspectives.
I enjoy listening, communicating and connecting different perspectives.
04 Reliable
Verify, don't assume.
When something requires accuracy, I prefer to verify rather than assume.
Closing
UNDERSTAND · STRUCTURE · CONNECT · VERIFY
